name: pr-steward
description: Sweep open non-draft pull requests in agent-of-empires once a day: list the ones ready for a maintainer to merge, ask authors of conflicted PRs once to rebase, rerun the failed jobs of a first CI attempt once when every failing test is a known flaky test, list stale contributor PRs a maintainer could take over, and keep one daily report comment on the Maintainer digest issue.
